name: Camp Three Rivers
description_short: A town-run summer day camp in Concord, MA, for children entering kindergarten through 8th grade, with a counselor-in-training (CIT) program for grades 9–10. Activities include swimming, art, sports, nature/science, music/drama and archery, plus weekly field trips. Older groups go on more trips each week.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming is listed as an activity for all age groups. The page does not say where swimming takes place or how it is supervised.

warnings: The page gives no dates, year or prices. The season year 2026 is worked out from '46th anniversary' since 1980, and that season is now over (today is 2026-10-13). Details for 2027 have not been posted on this page.
No bookable sessions are listed. The four programs (Assabet K-2, Sudbury 3-6, Trekkers 7-8, CIT 9-10) are age groups, not dated sessions. The CIT program runs in blocks of 2 consecutive weeks.
The street address and phone are for the Hunt Recreation Center contact office. This may not be where the camp itself takes place.
Staff are First Aid/CPR certified and the camp is licensed by the Concord Board of Health. ACA accreditation is not mentioned.
